heroDescription: Suzuki Alto, Mehran, Cultus, Wagon R and Bolan. Toyota Corolla, Yaris, Vitz, Prado and Hilux. Honda City, Civic and Vezel. Hand-picked, inspected stock with honest pricing — right here at Thanda Pani, Islamabad.
about: Alraffay Corporation & Traders is a family-run dealership on Latrar Road, Thanda Pani (Harnoi), Islamabad. For years we have been buying, checking and reselling Pakistan's most-loved cars: Suzuki Alto, Mehran, Cultus, Wagon R, Swift and Bolan, Toyota Corolla, Yaris, Vitz, Passo, Prado and Hilux, Honda City, Civic, BR-V and Vezel, along with Daihatsu, KIA, Hyundai and MG. Every car is inspected in our own workshop before it reaches the yard, documents are verified, and transfer support is included. Call either owner directly — you will always speak to the person who actually knows the car.

whyChooseUs.title: Inspected before listing
whyChooseUs.text: Every car goes through our own workshop check — engine, suspension, air-conditioning, tyres and documents — before it is listed here.

whyChooseUs.title: Honest, straight pricing
whyChooseUs.text: Market-linked prices with no hidden charges. What you see on the listing is the number you discuss at the yard.

whyChooseUs.title: Clear documents & transfer
whyChooseUs.text: Verified files, token tax and transfer support included. We handle the paperwork so you drive away without a headache.

whyChooseUs.title: Owner-level dealing
whyChooseUs.text: You deal directly with the owners — Chaudhry Naeem Akhtar and Chaudhry Faheem Akhtar — from the first call to delivery.

whyChooseUs.title: Trade-in & financing
whyChooseUs.text: Bring your current car for a fair exchange value, and ask us about easy bank financing and instalment plans.

whyChooseUs.title: Easy Islamabad location
whyChooseUs.text: Right on Latrar Road at Thanda Pani. Walk in any working day, take a test drive and check the car yourself.
